method: Blinded rating from trial designs only (trial_specs.py arms/gates/exclusions/OUTCOMES/HORIZON_MONTHS/notes, rct_facts.json protocol facts, and rater knowledge of the published protocols); no emulation results viewed. Items follow Wang et al. JAMA 2023 / Heyard et al. BMJ Med 2024: (a) in-hospital start not mirrored by emulation time zero (EHR sees inpatient orders, so only flagged where time zero/treatment cannot match); (b) run-in selecting responders/tolerators (placebo-only washout/adherence run-ins not flagged); (c) randomization combined with discontinuation/switching of baseline therapy not mirrored; (d) delayed effect expected with long follow-up (flagged only where a benefit accrues over years: COMET, LIFE, EAST-AFNET 4). Comparator: good = same agent; moderate = class adaptation, placebo->active proxy, dose not identifiable, or strategy approximated; poor = agent/formulation mismatch that changes the tested hypothesis. Outcome: good = all-cause death or stroke/SE from inpatient codes; moderate = composites needing CV death from listed causes and/or HF/MI hospitalisation by any-position codes. close_emulation = none of a-d AND comparator and outcome >= moderate AND at least one good. Dose titration and placebo proxy recorded only.

comet.in_hospital_start_why: Outpatient chronic HFrEF trial; initiator time zero at first beta-blocker order is compatible.
comet.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Trial enrolled beta-blocker-naive patients on background ACEi/diuretic; no switching at randomization that the new-user design misses.
comet.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 58-month horizon (mean follow-up ~58 mo); carvedilol-vs-metoprolol mortality difference accrued gradually over years, which ITT initiator analysis with real-world beta-blocker switching/discontinuation cannot reproduce.
comet.comparator_emulation_why: Trial comparator was immediate-release metoprolol tartrate 50 mg bid; the arm token set ('metoprolol','toprol','lopressor') cannot separate tartrate from succinate, and US HFrEF practice is predominantly succinate (an evidence-based agent), so the hypothesis being tested differs.
comet.outcome_emulation_why: All-cause mortality from EHR death records.
comet.notes: Not close: delayed effect over long follow-up and formulation-level comparator mismatch.

paradigm_hf_seq.in_hospital_start_why: Outpatient trial; sequential switcher design sets time zero at the ACEi/ARB->ARNI switch, matching randomization of already-treated patients.
paradigm_hf_seq.responder_run_in_why: Sequential single-blind active run-in (enalapril then sacubitril/valsartan) excluded ~20% intolerant/non-tolerating patients before randomization.
paradigm_hf_seq.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Trial stopped baseline ACEi/ARB at randomization; the switcher-vs-established-ACEi-user design mirrors this reasonably.
paradigm_hf_seq.comparator_emulation_why: Comparator is any established ACEi at usual doses rather than target-dose enalapril 10 mg bid; ARB users in trial were switched to enalapril.
paradigm_hf_seq.outcome_emulation_why: CV death from listed-cause vital statistics (unknown cause counted CV) plus HF hospitalisation by any-position I50 code, vs adjudicated endpoints.

transform_hf.in_hospital_start_why: Trial randomized hospitalised HF patients to a discharge loop-diuretic strategy; the emulation's 'furosemide initiation' in the 30-day HF window is dominated by inpatient IV furosemide orders (route not distinguishable), so time zero/treatment do not match the discharge oral strategy.
transform_hf.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Most trial patients were on a loop diuretic before admission and were switched to the assigned drug; the new-user design excludes/omits these prevalent users.
transform_hf.comparator_emulation_why: Active comparator identical (furosemide), though formulation (IV vs oral) not separable - handled under item a.
transform_hf.notes: Not close: in-hospital/IV time-zero mismatch and switching of prevalent loop-diuretic users.

elite_ii.in_hospital_start_why: Outpatient HFrEF trial; initiator time zero compatible.
elite_ii.responder_run_in_why: Only a short single-blind placebo lead-in (adherence), not selection on response to active drug.
elite_ii.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Trial enrolled ACEi/ARB-naive patients (limited prior exposure), consistent with a new-user design.
elite_ii.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: Median ~18-month horizon; no delayed effect expected.
elite_ii.comparator_emulation_why: Class adaptation: any ARB vs any ACEi (trial: losartan 50 mg vs captopril 50 mg tid).
elite_ii.notes: Close emulation by the rule; class adaptation is the main difference.

life.responder_run_in_why: 1-2 week placebo run-in (washout), not selecting responders to active drug.
life.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Prior antihypertensive treatment was stopped (placebo washout) before randomization to losartan- or atenolol-based regimens; the emulation allows ongoing other agents.
life.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: ~58-month horizon; losartan advantage (stroke, LVH regression) accrued over years, not mirrorable with real-world persistence/switching.
life.comparator_emulation_why: Class adaptation (v2): any ARB vs cardioselective beta-blockers vs trial losartan vs atenolol; stepped add-on regimens not mirrored.
life.outcome_emulation_why: CV death (listed-cause) + MI/stroke hospitalisation codes vs adjudicated composite; ECG-LVH eligibility via ECG text is a strength.
life.notes: Not close: baseline therapy washout and delayed effect over long follow-up.

plato.in_hospital_start_why: Trial started drug at ACS presentation in hospital; EHR sees inpatient orders and time zero is first P2Y12 order within the ACS window, so time zero is broadly aligned (caveat: first order may precede angiography-driven choice).
plato.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: ~46% of PLATO patients were clopidogrel-pretreated and switched to ticagrelor on randomization; in US practice ED clopidogrel loading followed by ticagrelor is common, and a first-order initiator definition assigns these switchers to clopidogrel (or excludes them).
plato.outcome_emulation_why: CV death (listed-cause) + MI/stroke on subsequent inpatient stays; recurrent MI within the index admission and adjudicated definitions not captured.
plato.notes: Not close: pretreatment/switching at randomization not mirrored.

aristotle.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: VKA-experienced patients (~57%) switched to apixaban or continued warfarin; the new-user design omits them (population difference) but randomization was not combined with a discontinuation that affects the contrast.
aristotle.outcome_emulation_why: Stroke/systemic embolism from inpatient ICD-10 codes (high PPV).
aristotle.notes: Close. Warfarin INR-guided dosing not treated as titration.

rocket_af.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: VKA-experienced switchers not represented (population difference only).
rocket_af.outcome_emulation_why: Stroke/SE from inpatient codes; ITT benchmark used.
rocket_af.notes: Close. Trial population higher-risk (CHADS2>=2, mean 3.5) than an ungated AF cohort.

rely.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: VKA-experienced switchers not represented (population difference only).
rely.comparator_emulation_why: Warfarin comparator exact, but dabigatran dose (150 mg benchmark) not identifiable; US doses 150/75 mg, no 110 mg.
rely.notes: Close by rule; dose mixing is the main difference.

allhat.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: ~90% were on antihypertensives that were discontinued and replaced by the randomized drug; emulation new users keep background therapy.
allhat.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 59-month horizon but null effect and no specific delayed effect expected for CHD endpoint.
allhat.comparator_emulation_why: Thiazide class (mostly HCTZ in US practice) vs trial chlorthalidone; stepped regimens.
allhat.outcome_emulation_why: Fatal CHD from listed causes I20-I25 (not underlying cause) + MI hospitalisation codes.

emperor_preserved.comparator_emulation_why: Placebo emulated by DPP-4i active-comparator proxy; restricts to T2D (~49% of trial).
emperor_preserved.outcome_emulation_why: CV death (listed-cause, unknown=CV) + any-position I50 hospitalisation vs adjudicated endpoints; HFpEF by EF>40 or I503 code; no NT-proBNP criterion.
emperor_preserved.notes: Not close: neither comparator nor outcome rated good.

east_afnet4.in_hospital_start_why: Outpatient early-AF trial; rhythm-control starts (including inpatient dofetilide/sotalol loading) visible in EHR.
east_afnet4.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Add-on of rhythm control to rate control; sequential add-on design mirrors this.
east_afnet4.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 61-month horizon; benefit of early rhythm control emerged over years; real-world antiarrhythmic persistence is low and the ITT initiator contrast cannot mirror sustained strategy.
east_afnet4.comparator_emulation_why: Strategy trial (drug or ablation) vs usual care that permitted symptom-driven rhythm control; emulation = antiarrhythmic add-on vs established rate-control users; ablation-first not captured.
east_afnet4.outcome_emulation_why: Composite of CV death, stroke, HF and ACS hospitalisation from codes/listed causes.
east_afnet4.notes: Not close: delayed effect over long follow-up; strategy comparator only approximated.

cabana.in_hospital_start_why: Elective ablation and drug initiation both visible; time zero at procedure/first order; trial randomized before ablation (weeks gap) - minor.
cabana.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Ablation arm may have prior AADs, as in trial; mirrored in v2.
cabana.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 49-month horizon but no strong a priori delayed effect; one-off procedure not subject to persistence.
cabana.comparator_emulation_why: Drug arm restricted to antiarrhythmic initiators whereas trial drug arm allowed rate or rhythm control; heavy trial crossover (27.5%).
cabana.outcome_emulation_why: Death good, but disabling stroke -> any stroke, serious bleeding -> GI/ICH hospitalisation, cardiac arrest -> I46 on admission.
cabana.notes: Not close: neither comparator nor outcome good.

ontarget.responder_run_in_why: 3-week single-blind active run-in on ramipril and telmisartan+ramipril; intolerant/non-adherent patients excluded before randomization.
ontarget.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Patients had to be able to discontinue baseline ACEi/ARB, which was replaced by study drug; new-user design does not mirror.
ontarget.comparator_emulation_why: Class adaptation: any ARB vs any ACEi (trial telmisartan 80 vs ramipril 10).
ontarget.notes: Not close: active run-in and baseline ACEi/ARB discontinuation.

value.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Previously treated patients (~90%) stopped prior antihypertensives and switched directly to randomized drug.
value.comparator_emulation_why: ARB class vs valsartan; amlodipine exact; stepwise HCTZ add-on regimens.
value.outcome_emulation_why: Complex cardiac composite (sudden cardiac death, fatal/nonfatal MI, HF death/hospitalisation, emergency procedures) approximated by CV death + HF + MI hospitalisation.

ascot.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Most patients were previously treated and prior antihypertensives were replaced by randomized regimens.
ascot.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 66-month horizon, no strong delayed-effect expectation for CHD endpoint (borderline).
ascot.comparator_emulation_why: Beta-blocker class (atenolol + metoprolol/bisoprolol/nebivolol) vs trial atenolol; perindopril/bendroflumethiazide add-on strategies not mirrored.
ascot.outcome_emulation_why: Fatal CHD (listed cause) + MI hospitalisation; silent MI not captured.

empa_reg.responder_run_in_why: 2-week open-label placebo run-in only (adherence), not responder selection.
empa_reg.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: Added on to stable background glucose-lowering therapy; mirrored.
empa_reg.comparator_emulation_why: Placebo emulated with DPP-4i proxy (as in RCT-DUPLICATE); pooled empagliflozin doses vs any SGLT2i.
empa_reg.outcome_emulation_why: 3-point MACE: CV death by listed cause (unknown=CV) + MI/stroke hospitalisation codes.
empa_reg.notes: Not close by rule: neither rated good (RCT-DUPLICATE analogue emulations agreed well, but rule applied strictly).

carolina.baseline_therapy_discontinuation_why: SU users at screening had SU replaced by study drug; emulation permits prior non-glimepiride SU users to initiate either arm, partially mirroring - not flagged (borderline).
carolina.delayed_effect_long_followup_why: 76-month horizon but null effect and no delayed effect expected for a DPP-4i vs SU safety comparison.
carolina.outcome_emulation_why: 3-point MACE from listed-cause CV death + MI/stroke hospitalisation codes.
carolina.notes: Close by rule; high-CV-risk criterion not applied (population difference).
